decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template is cheap to maintain, fits the firm's agency and shop-hosting customers, and supports demand for its hosting packages.
A responsive website template sits close to the core offer, costs little to keep, and helps agencies start projects on the platform.
Premium support builds directly on the firm's main differentiator of round-the-clock expert service and earns extra revenue from agency clients.
The version management tool has its own page and serves the firm's aim of tools that reduce developers' recurring operational work, so it is a strategic part of the platform.
Although it is far from the core business, the data processing contract tool answers real GDPR demand after 2018, has its own page, and costs little to run, so the firm will likely keep it for now.
